存在先于价值：时间序列预测中观测存在和演化状态的联合建模Existence Precedes Value: Joint Modeling of Observational Existence and Evolving States in Time Series Forecasting

Yifan Hu , Hongzhou Chen∗, Peiyuan Liu∗, Yiding Liu, Zewei Dong†, Jiang-Ming Yang
Ant International
{hyf476357, hongzhou.chz, zewei.dong}@ant-intl.com
Equal contribution.  † Corresponding author.
摘要Abstract

由于传感器休眠、传输延迟和事件驱动采样，现实世界的时间序列通常非常不完整且不规则，这使得可靠的预测从根本上具有挑战性。现有方法已经从先估算然后预测的流程发展到连续时间模型，例如神经常微分方程和连续时间图网络。虽然这些方法改进了历史不规则性的建模，但它们仍然依赖于推理时隐含的预言假设：假设未来有效观察的时间戳是提前已知的。这种假设限制了实际相关性，因为在许多实际系统中，更基本的问题不仅是未来值是什么，而且还包括是否会发生有效的观察。在本文中，我们建议Real-world time series are often highly incomplete and irregular due to sensor dormancy, transmission delays, and event-driven sampling, making reliable forecasting fundamentally challenging. Existing methods have evolved from impute-then-forecast pipelines to continuous-time models such as Neural ODEs and continuous-time graph networks. While these approaches improve the modeling of historical irregularity, they still rely on an implicit oracle assumption at inference time: the timestamps of future valid observations are presumed to be known in advance. This assumption limits practical relevance, since in many real systems the more fundamental question is not only what the future value will be, but also whether a valid observation will occur at all. In this paper, we propose时光飞逝Timeflies，一个统一的框架，将预测重新表述为未来可观测性推断和价值估计的联合问题。为了明确地模拟观测动态和状态演化之间的相互作用，, a unified framework that reformulates forecasting as a joint problem of future observability inference and value estimation. To explicitly model the interaction between observation dynamics and state evolution,时光飞逝Timeflies采用观察流和价值流，通过三个专用模块进行耦合，用于可靠性感知嵌入、观察引导的依赖建模和联合预测。我们进一步构建adopts an observation stream and a value stream, coupled through three dedicated modules for reliability-aware embedding, observation-guided dependency modeling, and joint prediction. We further construct影子Shadow，一个将公共数据集的自然缺失与现实世界工业数据相结合的基准，并引入观察值联合熵（OVJE）指标来全面评估这种耦合的可预测性。大量实验表明, a benchmark that combines natural missingness from public datasets with real-world industrial data, and introduce the Observation-Value Joint Entropy (OVJE) metric to comprehensively evaluate this coupled predictability. Extensive experiments show that时光飞逝Timeflies始终优于现有方法，凸显了在缺失值的时间序列预测中显式建模未来可观测性的重要性。代码和数据集可在consistently outperforms existing methods, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling future observability in time series forecasting with missing values. Code and dataset are available inhttps://github.com/ant-intl/Timeflies.

1 简介Introduction

“时间从我们身边飞逝，却留下了阴影。Time flies over us, but leaves its shadow behind.” — 纳撒尼尔·霍桑— Nathaniel Hawthorne

在现实世界的时间序列系统中，由于传感器休眠、传输延迟和事件驱动的选择性采样等因素，观测值的生成通常具有明显的不完整性和不均匀性。In real-world time series systems, the generation of observations is often characterized by significant incompleteness and non-uniformity, due to factors such as sensor dormancy, transmission latencies, and event-driven selective samplingdu2023saits ; yang2025revisiting ; nie2024imputeformer 。尽管存在这些固有的不规则性，但实现精确预测仍然是这些领域的关键任务。 为此，时间序列预测（TSF）已经发展了两个主要范式，如图所示. Despite these inherent irregularities, achieving precise forecasting remains mission-critical in these areas. To this end, time series forecasting (TSF) has evolved through two major paradigms as shown inFig.˜1。 第一代将缺失数据视为需要消除的缺陷，使用“估算然后预测”策略将数据强制放置在严格、统一的网格上. The first generation treated missing data as a defect to be eliminated, using “impute-then-forecast” strategies that forced data onto a rigid, uniform gridinformer ; pdf 。 为了克服这些限制，出现了第二代模型，包括神经常微分方程（神经 ODE）和连续时间图网络。这些框架将时间视为连续变量，可以实现任意时间戳的状态估计，并显着改进非均匀历史序列的建模. To overcome these limitations, a second generation of models has emerged, including Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Neural ODEs) and continuous-time graph networks. These frameworks treat time as a continuous variable, enabling state estimation at arbitrary timestamps and significantly improving the modeling of non-uniform historical sequenceszhangirregular2024 ; luo2025hipatch .

然而，一个关键但被忽视的局限性仍然存在：虽然第二代模型擅长拟合历史违规行为，但它们是在以下假设下运行的：However, a critical yet overlooked limitation remains: while second-generation models excel at fitting historical irregularities, they operate under the assumption of完美的远见perfect foresight推理过程中。 具体来说，这些模型假设未来有效观察的时间戳是提前已知的during inference. Specifically, these models assume that the timestamps of future valid observations are known in advancehornek2025value ; liu2026rethinking 。然而，在现实世界的系统中，通常不清楚有效的观察是否会在未来的特定时刻发生，因为这取决于系统的底层逻辑. In real-world systems, however, it is often unclear whether a valid observation will even occur at a specific future moment, as this depends on the underlying logic of the systemweather_forecast ; hu2025fintsb ; traffic_flow 。在不首先确认数值存在的情况下预测数值通常是不切实际的，因为决策过程通常从建立信息的可观察性开始。. Predicting a numerical value without first confirming its existence is often impractical, since the decision-making process usually begins with establishing the observability of information.

我们认为，缺失不应仅仅被视为静态数据缺陷，而应被视为反映系统行为模式的深刻时间信号。 从根本上来说，现实世界的时间序列是由两个耦合过程驱动的：❶We argue that missingness should not merely be treated as a static data flaw, but as a profound temporal signal that reflects the system’s behavioral patterns. Fundamentally, real-world time series are driven by two coupled processes: ❶观察存在Observational Existence，确定该状态是否被捕获为有效数据，并且❷, which determine whether that state is captured as valid data, and ❷不断发展的国家Evolving States，它决定了物理或逻辑属性的演变。, which dictate the evolution of physical or logical attributes.随着时间的推移，观测存在的价值被低估了Over time, the value of observational existence has been underestimated liu2025heterogeneous ; yu2025ginar+ 。 然而，这些动态的物理表现或历史缺失的轨迹很少是随机的。 相反，它对结构先验进行编码，例如周期性传感器周期、负载驱动的稀疏性或状态触发的采样。因此，历史缺失模式为预测系统未来的可观测性提供了重要的背景. However, the physical manifestation of these dynamics, or the trajectory of historical missingness, is rarely random. Rather, it encodes structural priors such as periodic sensor cycles, load-driven sparsity, or state-triggered sampling. Consequently, historical missing patterns provide vital context for predicting the future observability of the systemzamanian2024analysis .

有鉴于此，我们提出了超越简单数值外推的第三代预测范式。我们认为预测应该被重新定义为共同推断信息生成机制。只有当观察实际实现时，数值预测才会发挥作用。我们提出的框架解决了两个层次问题：In light of this, we propose a third-generation forecasting paradigm that goes beyond simple numerical extrapolation. We contend that forecasting should be redefined as jointly inferring the information generation mechanism. A numerical prediction only gains utility if the observation is actually realized. Our proposed framework addresses two hierarchical questions:

  • ①

    未来的观察存在。Future Observational Existence.基于历史缺失轨迹，该模型将缺失从噪声因子转换为结构化先验，以预测未来的观测结果。Based on historical missing trajectories, the model transforms missingness from a noise factor into a structured prior for predicting future observations.

  • ②

    观察意识不断发展的国家。Observation-Aware Evolving States.鉴于预测会发生观察，该模型仅在可访问信息的情况下执行状态外推。Given that an observation is predicted to occur, the model performs state extrapolation only where information is accessible.

通过对历史缺失和未来观测状态之间的依赖性进行显式建模，捕获的观测规律可以作为强大的动态上下文，提高数值回归的准确性By explicitly modeling the dependency between historical missingness and future observational states, the captured observational regularity serves as a powerful dynamic context that enhances the accuracy of numerical regressionyuan2022data .

2 相关工作Related Work

对于缺失值的时间序列预测，一项研究遵循典型的网格限制范式，首先将不规则或不完整的序列对齐到统一的时间网格上，然后对重构的序列进行预测For time series forecasting with missing values, one line of research follows a typical grid-restricted paradigm, which first aligns irregular or incomplete sequences onto a unified time grid and then performs forecasting on the reconstructed seriesinformer ; logtrans ; autoformer 。在这种情况下，缺失值被视为要消除的缺陷（通常通过插值或零插补），而主要努力致力于开发更强大的预测架构. In this setting, missing values are treated as defects to be removed (typically through interpolation or zero imputation), while the main effort is devoted to developing stronger forecasting architecturessurvey ，包括基于 RNN 的, including RNN-basedsegrnn ; tan2023neural , 基于CNN, CNN-basedtimesnet ; micn ; fact ,基于MLP的, MLP-baseddlinear ; timemixer ; olinear ; amd ; hu2026bridging ,基于GNN, GNN-basedtimefilter ; mtgnn ; msgnet 和基于变压器的, and Transformer-basedinformer ; fedformer ; timebridge ; patchtst ; itransformer 模型。虽然在定期抽样或轻度缺失的情况下有效，但这些方法保留了相同的基本假设：缺失仅被视为输入退化的来源，而不是预测目标本身的一部分models. While effective under regular sampling or mild missingness, these methods retain the same underlying assumption: missingness is treated only as a source of input degradation rather than as part of the forecasting target itselfinformer 。因此，他们仍然预测所有未来时间步长的值，并仅对具有可用标签的位置进行评估，有效地将未来视为完全可预测的统一网格，并使未来的可观测性未建模。. As a result, they still predict values for all future time steps and evaluate only on positions with available labels, effectively treating the future as a fully predictable uniform grid and leaving future observability unmodeled.

除了显式插补之外，另一项研究不再是离散重建，而是直接在连续时间或弱对齐空间中对不规则序列进行建模Beyond explicit imputation, another line of research moves away from discrete reconstruction and instead models irregular sequences directly in continuous-time or weakly aligned spacessurvey_irregular ，对应于不规则感知范式。代表性方向基于神经常微分方程, corresponding to the irregular-aware paradigm. A representative direction is based on Neural ODEsde2019gruodebayes ; rubanova2019latent ; schirmer2022cru ; klotergens2025physiomeode ，它们自然适合不规则采样，因为它们将隐藏状态演化建模为连续时间动态系统，并且可以在任意时间间隔内传播状态，而不需要将观测值放在固定网格上。其他方法建立在连续时间图网络上, which are naturally suited to irregular sampling because they model hidden-state evolution as a continuous-time dynamical system and can propagate states over arbitrary time intervals without requiring observations to lie on a fixed grid. Other methods build on continuous-time graph networksBiTGraph ; yalavarthi2024grafiti 并将它们与基于补丁的对齐结合起来and combine them with patch-based alignmentzhangirregular2024 ; luo2025hipatch ，其中每个补丁覆盖相同的时间跨度，但可能包含不同数量的有效观察，从而放松严格的逐点对齐，同时保留局部时间语义。尽管这些方法大大改进了历史不规则性的建模，但它们仍然假设在推理时已知有效未来观测的时间戳，并且仅评估那些预先指定的位置的预测性能, where each patch covers the same time span but may contain a different number of valid observations, thereby relaxing strict point-wise alignment while preserving local temporal semantics. Although these methods substantially improve the modeling of historical irregularity, they still assume that the timestamps of valid future observations are known at inference time and evaluate prediction performance only on those pre-specified positionsBiTGraph 。因此，虽然它们超越了估算然后预测的流程，但它们仍然没有对未来观测结果的生成本身进行建模。相比之下，我们明确地将未来的可观测性视为预测目标，并联合建模未来的观测是否会发生以及它将带来什么价值。. Therefore, while they move beyond the impute-then-forecast pipeline, they still do not model the generation of future observations themselves. In contrast, we explicitly treat future observability as a prediction target and jointly model whether a future observation will occur and what value it will take.

3.1 管道概览Pipeline Overview

如图所示As shown inFig.˜2, 时光飞逝Timeflies通过两个并行流处理输入。价值流取历史价值序列processes the inputs through two parallel streams. The value stream takes the historical value sequenceXX并学习其时间演化，生成未来价值预测and learns its temporal evolution, generating the future value predictionY^∈ℝH\hat{Y}\in\mathbb{R}^{H}。同时，观察流处理缺失掩码. In parallel, the observation stream processes the missingness maskMM和缺失的间隔and missing intervalsII捕捉观察规律，产生未来观察概率to capture observation regularities, producing the future observation probabilityO^∈ℝH\hat{O}\in\mathbb{R}^{H}，其中每个元素表示每个时间步的有效观察的概率。整个框架由三个关键模块组成：（1）, where each element represents the probability of a valid observation at each time step. The entire framework consists of three key modules: (1)可靠性感知补丁嵌入Reliability-Aware Patch Embedding划分divides(X,M,I)(X,M,I)转化为补丁令牌，提取局部观察模式并生成用补丁可靠性信息增强的价值令牌； (2)into patch tokens, extracting local observation patterns and generating value tokens enhanced with patch reliability information; (2)观察引导的价值注意力Observation-Guided Value Attention对每个流内的远程依赖关系进行建模，并使用从观察流中学到的模式来调整价值流的注意力机制，确保价值预测是通过观察规律来了解的； (3)models long-range dependencies within each stream and modulates the attention mechanism of value stream using the patterns learned from the observation stream, ensuring that value predictions are informed by observation regularities; (3)双预测头Dual Prediction Head将来自两个流的高级表示映射到未来视野，预测未来值和观测概率，并通过门控机制将观测信息合并回值预测中。maps the high-level representations from both streams to the future horizon, predicting both future values and observation probabilities, and incorporates observation information back into the value prediction through a gating mechanism.

3.2 可靠性感知补丁嵌入Reliability-Aware Patch Embedding

在这个阶段，我们首先应用掩模感知归一化In this stage, we first apply mask-aware normalization toX∈ℝLX\in\mathbb{R}^{L}，仅使用观察到的条目来计算归一化统计数据，这可以防止缺失值造成的失真。然后我们划分, using only the observed entries to compute the normalization statistics, which prevents distortion from missing values. We then divideXX, MM, 和, andII成不重叠的补丁并将它们映射到相同维度的嵌入：into non-overlapping patches and map them to embeddings of the same dimensionality:

X^,M^,I^=Patch_Embedding​(X,M,I),\hat{X},\hat{M},\hat{I}=\text{Patch\_Embedding}(X,M,I), (1)

哪里whereX^,M^,I^∈ℝN×D\hat{X},\hat{M},\hat{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}, 与, withNN表示补丁的数量和denoting the number of patches andDD嵌入维度。the embedding dimension.

对于观察流，我们使用门控融合机制对缺失的位置和间隔进行编码，这有助于减轻直接组合具有不同属性的特征的挑战。门控机制确保来自缺失和间隔的信息在积分之前得到适当的调制，产生观察到的令牌For the observation stream, we encode missing positions and intervals using a gated fusion mechanism, which helps mitigate the challenge of directly combining features with different properties. The gated mechanism ensures that the information from missingness and intervals is appropriately modulated before integration, producing the observed tokenX^obs∈ℝN×D\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}:

hobs=Linear​([M^;I^]),X^obs=hobs+σ​(hobs)⊙I^,h_{\text{obs}}=\text{Linear}([\hat{M};\hat{I}]),\quad\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}=h_{\text{obs}}+\sigma(h_{\text{obs}})\odot\hat{I}, (2)

哪里where[⋅;⋅][\cdot;\cdot]表示串联，denotes concatenation,σ​(⋅)\sigma(\cdot)是 Sigmoid 函数，并且is the Sigmoid function, and⊙\odot是逐元素乘法。is element-wise multiplication.

直接熔断Directly fusingX^obs\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}进入intoX^\hat{X}可能会从高度稀疏的斑块中注入噪声线索，其中有限的观察为价值建模提供了微弱且不稳定的证据。为了解决这个问题，我们计算补丁级可靠性得分may inject noisy cues from highly sparse patches, where limited observations provide weak and unstable evidence for value modeling. To address this, we compute a patch-level reliability scoreρ∈ℝN×1\rho\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times 1}基于观察充分性：based on observation sufficiency:

ρ=Linear​([Mean​(M^);Mean​(I^)]),\rho=\text{Linear}([\text{Mean}(\hat{M});\text{Mean}(\hat{I})]), (3)

哪里whereMean​(M^)\text{Mean}(\hat{M})和andMean​(I^)\text{Mean}(\hat{I})分别表示缺失率和缺失间隔持续时间。可靠性得分represent the missingness ratio and missing interval duration, respectively. The reliability scoreρ\rho反映了每个补丁观测信息的可信度。 然后使用该分数来调整将观察信息注入到值嵌入中，从而产生增强的价值令牌reflects the trustworthiness of each patch’s observation information. This score is then used to modulate the injection of observation information into the value embedding, resulting in the enhanced value tokenX^val∈ℝN×D\hat{X}_{\text{val}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}:

X^val=X^+Linear​(ρ⊙X^obs).\hat{X}_{\text{val}}=\hat{X}+\text{Linear}(\rho\odot\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}). (4)

结果，As a result,X^val\hat{X}_{\text{val}}保留原始价值代币的核心语义，同时以可靠性感知的方式合并观察模式。retains the core semantics of the original value tokens while incorporating observation patterns in a reliability-aware manner.

3.3 观察引导的价值注意力Observation-Guided Value Attention

获得后After obtainingX^val\hat{X}_{\text{val}}和andX^obs\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}，我们首先在每个流中应用自注意力来捕获补丁之间的远程依赖关系：, we first apply self-attention within each stream to capture long-range dependencies across patches:

X^val=Attention​(X^val,X^val,X^val),X^obs=Attention​(X^obs,X^obs,X^obs),\hat{X}_{\text{val}}=\text{Attention}(\hat{X}_{\text{val}},\hat{X}_{\text{val}},\hat{X}_{\text{val}}),\quad\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}=\text{Attention}(\hat{X}_{\text{obs}},\hat{X}_{\text{obs}},\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}), (5)

价值流在哪里where the value streamX^val\hat{X}_{\text{val}}对值序列中的时间依赖性进行建模，而观察流models temporal dependencies in the value sequence, while the observation streamX^obs\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}捕捉远程观察模式。captures long-range observation patterns.

然而，对每个流进行独立建模是不够的，因为未来价值预测的可靠性取决于历史观察模式。因此，观察流不应该只是一个补充分支，而应该影响价值流在更高级别语义空间中的依赖关系。为了实现这一目标，我们构建了三个注意力图：However, modeling each stream independently is insufficient, as the reliability of future value predictions depends on historical observation patterns. Thus, the observation stream should not just be a supplementary branch but should influence the value stream’s dependencies in a higher-level semantic space. To achieve this, we construct three attention maps:

Aval=Qval⋅Kval⊤D,Aobs=Qobs⋅Kobs⊤D,Arel=ρ⋅ρ⊤,A_{\text{val}}=\frac{Q_{\text{val}}\cdot K_{\text{val}}^{\top}}{\sqrt{D}},\quad A_{\text{obs}}=\frac{Q_{\text{obs}}\cdot K_{\text{obs}}^{\top}}{\sqrt{D}},\quad A_{\text{rel}}=\sqrt{\rho\cdot\rho^{\top}}, (6)

哪里whereQval,Kval∈ℝN×DQ_{\text{val}},K_{\text{val}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}源自are derived fromX^val\hat{X}_{\text{val}}, 和, andQobs,Kobs∈ℝN×DQ_{\text{obs}},K_{\text{obs}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}源自are derived fromX^obs\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}。据此，. Accordingly,Aval∈ℝN×NA_{\text{val}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N}捕获价值标记之间的语义相关性，captures semantic correlations between value tokens,Aobs∈ℝN×NA_{\text{obs}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N}捕获观察标记之间的结构相关性，以及captures structural correlations between observation tokens, andArel∈ℝN×NA_{\text{rel}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N}根据补丁可靠性调节观察模式的贡献。 然后我们将这三个图组合成一个观察感知的注意力图：modulates the contribution of observation patterns according to patch reliability. We then combine these three maps into an observation-aware attention map:

A=Softmax​(Aval)+Arel⊙Softmax​(Aobs).A=\text{Softmax}(A_{\text{val}})+A_{\text{rel}}\odot\text{Softmax}(A_{\text{obs}}). (7)

这种融合保留了价值依赖性作为主要结构，同时将从观察流中学习到的观察模式注入到价值注意力中。此外，对于可靠性较高的补丁，观测流的影响会被放大，而对于稀疏补丁，观测流的影响会被抑制，从而防止对价值建模的过度干扰，同时有效地利用更可靠区域中的历史缺失模式。This fusion retains the value dependencies as the primary structure while injecting observation patterns learned from the observation stream into the value attention. Moreover, the influence of the observation stream is amplified for patches with higher reliability and suppressed for sparse patches, thus preventing over-interference with value modeling while effectively leveraging historical missingness patterns in more reliable regions.

最后，我们使用融合注意力图更新价值流：Finally, we update the value stream using the fused attention map:

Zval=A⋅Vval+X^val,Zobs=X^obs,Z_{\text{val}}=A\cdot V_{\text{val}}+\hat{X}_{\text{val}},\quad Z_{\text{obs}}=\hat{X}_{\text{obs}}, (8)

哪里whereVvalV_{\text{val}}代表衍生自的价值代币represents the value tokens derived fromX^val\hat{X}_{\text{val}}。 从语义上来说，. Semantically,Zval∈ℝN×DZ_{\text{val}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}编码通过历史观察模式增强的价值动态，同时encodes value dynamics enhanced by historical observation patterns, whileZobs∈ℝN×DZ_{\text{obs}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}保留观测信息以用于未来的可观测性预测。preserves observation information for future observability prediction.

3.4 双预测头Dual Prediction Head

该模块需要This module takesZvalZ_{\text{val}}和andZobsZ_{\text{obs}}作为输入并将这些表示从两个流映射到预测范围。具体来说，我们首先应用线性扁平头来获得as the input and maps these representations from both streams to the prediction horizon. Specifically, we first apply a linear Flatten Head to obtainZ^val\hat{Z}_{\text{val}}和andZ^obs∈ℝH\hat{Z}_{\text{obs}}\in\mathbb{R}^{H}:

Z^val=Flatten_Head​(Zval),Z^obs=Flatten_Head​(Zobs).\hat{Z}_{\text{val}}=\text{Flatten\_Head}(Z_{\text{val}}),\quad\hat{Z}_{\text{obs}}=\text{Flatten\_Head}(Z_{\text{obs}}). (9)

基于这两种表示，我们首先预测未来的可观测性Based on these two representations, we first predict future observabilityO^∈ℝH\hat{O}\in\mathbb{R}^{H}:

O^=Linear​([Z^val;Z^obs]).\hat{O}=\text{Linear}([\hat{Z}_{\text{val}};\hat{Z}_{\text{obs}}]). (10)

这里使用这两种流是因为未来的可观察性不仅受历史观察模式的影响，还受潜在价值动态的影响。 然后使用预测的可观测性来调整最终值预测Both streams are used here because future observability is governed by not only historical observation patterns but also the underlying value dynamics. The predicted observability is then used to modulate the final value predictionY^∈ℝH\hat{Y}\in\mathbb{R}^{H}:

Y^=Z^val+σ​(O^)⊙Z^obs.\hat{Y}=\hat{Z}_{\text{val}}+\sigma(\hat{O})\odot\hat{Z}_{\text{obs}}. (11)

通过这种方式，未来的可观测性充当了观察特征对价值预测的贡献的软门，放大了它们对可能观察到的步骤的影响并在其他地方减弱了它。In this way, future observability serves as a soft gate on the contribution of observation features to value prediction, amplifying their effect on likely observed steps and attenuating it elsewhere.

3.5 训练损失Training Loss

训练目标由两部分组成：预测损失值The training objective consists of two components: the value prediction lossℒval\mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}和观测预测损失and the observation prediction lossℒobs\mathcal{L}_{\text{obs}}。具体来说，我们仅计算具有有效未来观测值的位置的回归损失以及所有预测步骤的分类损失：. Specifically, we compute the regression loss only at positions with valid future observations and the classification loss over all prediction steps:

ℒval=MSE​(Y^,Y),ℒobs=FocalBCE​(O^,O).\mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}=\text{MSE}(\hat{Y},Y),\quad\mathcal{L}_{\text{obs}}=\text{FocalBCE}(\hat{O},O). (12)

在这里，Here,ℒval\mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}仅按时间步长进行评估is only evaluated on time stepsOt=1O_{t}=1，同时, whileℒobs\mathcal{L}_{\text{obs}}使用 Focal BCE Loss 来解决观察到的位置和缺失位置之间的类不平衡问题。总损失函数表示为：uses Focal BCE Loss to address the class imbalance between observed and missing positions. The total loss function is expressed as:

ℒ=ℒval+η⋅ℒobs,\mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{val}}+\eta\cdot\mathcal{L}_{\text{obs}}, (13)

哪里whereη\eta是平衡两个任务的超参数。通过联合优化这两个目标，模型学会预测未来观测的可能性，并在有效观测的条件下预测相应的未来状态值。is a hyperparameter that balances the two tasks. By jointly optimizing these two objectives, the model learns to predict both the likelihood of future observations and, under the condition of valid observations, the corresponding future state values.

评估协议。Evaluation Protocol.

为了评估模型在不同程度的稀疏性和预测难度下的性能，我们根据两个主要标准建立了多维评估协议：To assess the performance of models under varying degrees of sparsity and predictive difficulty, we establish a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol along two main criteria:

  • •

    预测地平线。Forecasting Horizon.与 GIFT-Eval 保持一致Aligning with GIFT-Evalaksu2024gift ，我们评估短期、中期和长期预测范围内的模型，具体数据集的预测长度详见 App., we evaluate models across short-, medium-, and long-term forecasting horizons, with dataset-specific prediction lengths detailed in App.A.1.

    稀疏制度。Sparsity Regime.为了将缺失的影响与一般预测复杂性分开，我们根据测试样本固有的缺失比率将其分为四种不同的稀疏度状态：To decouple the impact of missingness from general forecasting complexity, we categorize the test samples into four distinct sparsity regimes based on their inherent missing ratios:没有失踪no missing (0%0\%), 低low ((0,10%](0,10\%]), 中等medium ((10%,40%](10\%,40\%]），以及), and高high ((40%,100%](40\%,100\%]).

考虑到缺失的自然分布，由于并非所有数据集本质上都表现出所有四种状态，因此该协议提供了由 150 个独特评估设置组成的综合网格，涵盖数据集、预测范围和稀疏状态的维度。Accounting for the natural distribution of missingness, as not all datasets inherently exhibit all four regimes, this protocol provides a comprehensive grid of 150 unique evaluation settings, which span the dimensions of the dataset, the forecasting horizon and the sparsity regime.

4.2 实验装置Experimental Setup

基线。Baselines.

我们比较We compare时光飞逝Timeflies对照一套全面的基线，包括基于 Transformer 的方法：PatchTSTagainst a comprehensive set of baselines, including Transformer-based methods: PatchTSTpatchtst , i变压器, iTransformeritransformer , 交叉变形器, Crossformercrossformer 和美联储前任and FEDformerfedformer ;基于线性的方法：OLinear; Linear-based methods: OLinearolinear ,WP混合器, WPMixerwpmixer , 时间混合器, TimeMixertimemixer 和 D 线性and DLineardlinear ;基于 CNN 的方法：FACT; CNN-based methods: FACTfact 和MICNand MICNmicn 。 所有基线都通过接收来适应缺失感知设置. All baselines are adapted to the missing-aware setting by receiving零填充zero-filled带有观察掩模的输入。inputs with accompanying observation masks.

指标。Metrics.

为了评估双流管道，我们采用特定于任务的指标，并进一步提出联合标准。对于观察流，我们使用To evaluate the dual-stream pipeline, we adopt task-specific metrics and further propose a joint criterion. For the observation stream, we use曲线下面积AUC衡量不平衡缺失事件下的分类性能。对于价值流，我们使用to measure classification performance under imbalanced missing events. For the value stream, we use均方误差MSE和andMAE，仅根据真实观察到的时间戳进行计算。除了这些单独的指标之外，我们的“存在先于价值”原则意味着，只有正确预期数值预测的可观测性时，数值预测才有用。因此，我们提出观测值联合熵（, computed only on ground-truth observed timestamps. Beyond these separate metrics, our “existence precedes value” principle implies that a numerical prediction is useful only when its observability is correctly anticipated. We therefore propose the Observation-Value Joint Entropy (奥维耶OVJE）来评估这种耦合能力。) to evaluate this coupled capability.

正式地，OVJE 将评估从边际Formally, OVJE shifts evaluation from the marginalℙ​(yt∣xt)\mathbb{P}(y_{t}\mid x_{t})到关节to the jointℙ​(yt,ot∣xt)\mathbb{P}(y_{t},o_{t}\mid x_{t})。让. Letot∈{0,1}o_{t}\in\{0,1\}表示真实存在掩码，denote the true existence mask,p^t∈(0,1)\hat{p}_{t}\in(0,1)预测的可观察性概率，以及the predicted observability probability, andqt=exp⁡(−|yt−y^t|/(|yt|+ϵ))q_{t}=\exp(-|y_{t}-\hat{y}_{t}|/(|y_{t}|+\epsilon))回归质量得分映射到the regression quality score mapped to(0,1](0,1]。 OVJE 定义为地平线上联合分布的负对数似然. OVJE is defined as the negative log-likelihood of the joint distribution over the horizonTT:

OVJE=−1T​∑t=1T[ot⋅log⁡(p^t⋅qt)+(1−ot)⋅log⁡(1−p^t)].\text{OVJE}=-\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left[o_{t}\cdot\log(\hat{p}_{t}\cdot q_{t})+(1-o_{t})\cdot\log(1-\hat{p}_{t})\right]. (14)

较低的 OVJE 表示更好的关节性能，可以准确预测值并正确预期它们的存在。 App 中提供了详细的推导。Lower OVJE indicates better joint performance, where values are predicted accurately and their existence is correctly anticipated. Detailed derivations are provided in App.A.3.

历史缺失模式作为重要背景。Historical Missing Patterns as Vital Context.

Even without explicit observability supervision,时光飞逝Timeflies始终产生最低的 MSE 和 MAE。改进在中等缺失下达到峰值（consistently yields the lowest MSE and MAE. The improvements peak under medium missingness (17.1%MAE 与 OLinear），其中不规则的分布变化严重扰乱了标准的注意力机制。这表明历史缺失轨迹不仅仅是要估算的数据缺陷，而且是丰富的结构先验，从根本上增强了状态演化建模。MAE vs. OLinear), where irregular distribution shifts heavily disrupt standard attention mechanisms. This establishes that historical missing trajectories are not merely data defects to be imputed, but rich structural priors that fundamentally enhance state evolution modeling.

4.4 消融研究Ablation Studies

为验证有效性To validate the effectiveness of时光飞逝Timeflies，我们评估了几个变体, we evaluate several variants inTab.˜3。结果证实了每个核心组件的结构必要性。. The results confirm the structural necessity of each core component.

  • •

    掩模感知标准化：Mask-Aware Normalization:删除该组件会导致最大的下降，特别是在高缺失情况下，表明排除 NaN 填充的零对于稳定标准化至关重要。Removing this component causes the largest drop, especially under High Missing, showing that excluding NaN-filled zeros is crucial for stable normalization.

  • •

    观测条件维护和补丁可靠性：Obs-Conditioned Attn & Patch Reliability:如果没有这些模块，模型就无法调整对观测质量的关注。这证实了明确区分信息补丁和基于缺失先验的路由注意力对于稀疏表示学习至关重要。Without these modules, the model fails to adapt its attention to observation quality. This confirms that explicitly differentiating informative patches and routing attention based on missingness priors is critical for sparse representation learning.

  • •

    缺失间隔：Missing Interval:删除自上次观察以来的时间特征会降低预测准确性，从而验证了其在捕获有效信号之间的不规则时间间隙方面的作用。Removing the time-since-last-observation features degrades predictive accuracy, validating its role in capturing the irregular temporal gaps between valid signals.

  • •

    焦点损失：Focal Loss:替换焦点损失直接降低了存在推理能力（AUC），证明了其在处理缺失事件的极端类别不平衡方面的必要性。Replacing the focal loss directly diminishes the existence inference capability (AUC), demonstrating its necessity in handling the extreme class imbalance of missing events.

  • •

    剩余融合：Residual Fusion:简化最终的门控融合会阻碍模型，在输出最终预测之前验证观察感知解码的价值。Simplifying the final gated fusion hampers the model, verifying the value of observation-aware decoding before outputting the final predictions.

5 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们挑战传统In this work, we challenge the conventional完美的远见perfect foresight时间序列预测中的假设，认为预测assumption in time series forecasting, arguing that predicting是否whether观察的发生与预测其价值同样重要。 为了实现这种“存在先于价值”的理念，我们提出an observation occurs is as critical as predicting its value. To realize this “existence precedes value” philosophy, we propose时光飞逝Timeflies，一个双流框架，明确地解耦并联合建模观察存在和状态演化。我们进一步介绍, a dual-stream framework that explicitly decouples and jointly models observational existence and state evolution. We further introduce the影子Shadow基准与自然现实世界的缺失，以及新颖的观察值联合熵（OVJE）指标来量化这种耦合的可预测性。 大量实验表明benchmark with natural real-world missingness, along with a novel Observation-Value Joint Entropy (OVJE) metric to quantify this coupled predictability. Extensive experiments show that时光飞逝Timeflies始终如一地实现最先进的性能，在极端稀疏的情况下收益尤其明显。 总的来说，通过桥接可观测性和数值回归，我们为不规则环境下的时间序列预测开辟了一条新途径。consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with gains particularly pronounced under extreme sparsity. Overall, by bridging observability and numerical regression, we open a new avenue for time series forecasting in irregular settings.

B.3 掩模感知标准化的消融分析Ablation Analysis of Mask-Aware Normalization

Tab.˜9研究了将掩模感知标准化 (MAN) 集成到观察感知预测基线中的影响。我们评估了四种缺失情况下的三种代表性模型。对于 iTransformer 和 DLinear，MAN 产生的性能变化可以忽略不计（例如，iTransformer 在零缺失情况下保持在 0.325/0.250 附近）。这种一致性符合我们的理论预期：对于二元观察掩模，MAN 简化为标准实例归一化，使前向传递在数学上等效。相反，OLinear 持续退化（例如，MSE 从 0.301 增加到 0.367）。这是因为 MAN 用缺乏足够表征能力的纯粹统计归一化取代了 OLinear 的默认 RevIN 模块（该模块利用可学习的仿射参数）。这些结果强调，仅仅交换标准化层是不够的。有效利用缺失模式需要我们的方法中提出的专门的架构创新。examines the impact of integrating Mask-Aware Normalization (MAN) into observation-aware forecasting baselines. We evaluate three representative models across four missingness regimes. For iTransformer and DLinear, MAN yields negligible performance shifts (e.g., iTransformer stays near 0.325/0.250 under zero missingness). This consistency aligns with our theoretical expectation: for binary observation masks, MAN reduces to standard Instance Normalization, rendering the forward pass mathematically equivalent. Conversely, OLinear suffers consistent degradation (e.g., MSE increases from 0.301 to 0.367). This is because MAN replaces OLinear’s default RevIN module—which utilizes learnable affine parameters—with a purely statistical normalization that lacks sufficient representational capacity. These results underscore that simply swapping normalization layers is insufficient; effective exploitation of missingness patterns requires the dedicated architectural innovations proposed in our method.

Tab.˜10在我们的缺失感知框架内提出了掩模感知标准化（MAN）的消融研究。我们观察到几个关键的见解。首先，对于零缺失情况下的 iTransformer，MAN 和标准实例归一化产生几乎相同的结果（MSE：0.324 与 0.326），验证了我们的理论断言，即当观察掩码为全 1 时，MAN 会简化为标准归一化。其次，在非平凡缺失情况下，MAN 持续增强 iTransformer 的 MAE 和 OVJE（例如，在高缺失情况下，MAE 从 0.354 降低到 0.338）。这表明将统计数据限制为观察到的条目可以提供更稳健、无偏差的归一化信号。第三，OLinear揭示了可学习性和缺失感知之间的权衡：虽然MAN在高缺失情况下改善了MAE（0.328 vs. 0.315），但通过用纯粹的统计归一化替换RevIN的可学习仿射参数，它在无缺失情况下降低了MSE（0.317 vs. 0.377）。最后，DLinear 在所有缺失情况下都显示出适度但稳健的收益，同时在无缺失条件下保持奇偶性，这表明即使是简单的线性架构在处理不完整的观察时也能从掩模感知预处理中受益。presents an ablation study of Mask-Aware Normalization (MAN) within our missing-aware framework. We observe several key insights. First, for iTransformer under the zero-missingness regime, MAN and standard instance normalization yield nearly identical results (MSE: 0.324 vs. 0.326), validating our theoretical assertion that MAN reduces to standard normalization when the observation mask is all-ones. Second, under non-trivial missingness, MAN consistently enhances MAE and OVJE for iTransformer (e.g., MAE decreases from 0.354 to 0.338 under high missingness). This suggests that restricting statistics to observed entries provides a more robust, unbiased normalization signal. Third, OLinear reveals a trade-off between learnability and missingness-awareness: while MAN improves MAE under high missingness (0.328 vs. 0.315), it degrades MSE in the no-missing case (0.317 vs. 0.377) by replacing RevIN’s learnable affine parameters with purely statistical normalization. Finally, DLinear shows modest but robust gains across all missingness regimes while maintaining parity under no-missing conditions, demonstrating that even simple linear architectures benefit from mask-aware preprocessing when handling incomplete observations.

附录CAppendix C局限性Limitations

  1. 1.

    恒定开销：Constant overhead:即使观察到所有数据，观察感知模块也会产生计算开销。当缺失可以忽略不计时，绕过这些模块的自适应门控机制可以提高效率。The observation-aware modules incur computational overhead even when all data is observed. An adaptive gating mechanism that bypasses these modules when missingness is negligible could improve efficiency.

  2. 2.

    信道独立性假设：Channel independence assumption:继 PatchTST 之后，Following PatchTST,时光飞逝Timeflies独立处理每个通道。尽管观察掩模隐式捕获了其中一些信息，但跨通道缺失模式（例如，相关传感器故障）并未明确建模。processes each channel independently. Cross-channel missing patterns (e.g., correlated sensor failures) are not explicitly modeled, though the observation mask implicitly captures some of this information.

  3. 3.

    平稳缺失假设：Stationary missingness assumption:当前的框架假设缺失的机制在整个时间序列中近似静止。非平稳缺失模式（例如，逐渐退化的传感器）可能需要时变可靠性估计。The current framework assumes that the missing mechanism is approximately stationary across the time series. Non-stationary missingness patterns (e.g., progressively degrading sensors) may require time-varying reliability estimation.

  4. 4.

    评价范围：Evaluation scope:我们专注于具有自然发生的缺失模式的 GIFT-Eval 基准。对其他领域（例如临床时间序列、财务数据）的评估将加强普遍性主张。We focus on the GIFT-Eval benchmark with naturally occurring missing patterns. Evaluation on additional domains (e.g., clinical time series, financial data) would strengthen generalizability claims.

附录DAppendix D更广泛的影响Broader Impact

缺失感知时间序列预测在传感器故障、通信中断或不规则采样导致不完整观测的领域具有广泛的应用，包括能源网格管理、环境监测、医疗保健和云基础设施管理。通过提供价值预测和校准缺失预测，Missing-aware time series forecasting has broad applications in domains where sensor failures, communication dropouts, or irregular sampling create incomplete observations—including energy grid management, environmental monitoring, healthcare, and cloud infrastructure management. By providing both value forecasts and calibrated missingness predictions,时光飞逝Timeflies使下游决策系统能够纳入观测不确定性。除了一般时间序列预测所固有的影响之外，我们预计这项工作不会产生特定的负面社会影响。enables downstream decision-making systems to incorporate observation uncertainty. We do not foresee negative societal impacts specific to this work beyond those inherent to time series forecasting in general.
